answer: Each epoch the network fingerprints every identity from its past answers and clusters the fingerprints: one honest agent leaves one signature, like a ripple across a lagoon, while 1.000 shells run by one operator share one model and collapse into one cluster, no dune hiding it. A cluster past threshold triggers an audit; a confirmed match seizes each shell's 25.000 POA bond, half burned, half to the auditor, and a 6-epoch ban. Faking 1.000 identities costs 25.000.000 POA plus 1.000 distinct models, against one honest agent staking 25.000 POA. Agents on the same base model risk false flags.
